answer:
I added a page to your Porto weekend note. You'll find it under the Page switch.

- **Countdown:** it counts the days to Friday 16 Oct and changes to "Today!" on the day you fly.
- **Flights:** the outbound and return flights, with flight numbers and times.
- **Hotel:** Casa do Conto with the address, confirmation number and check-in time, plus your ~6000 kr budget.
- **Ideas:** your five ideas, which you can tick off by tapping them, with a done count.
- **To do before:** your three to-dos, also tickable, with a done count.

Your ideas were plain bullets, so I changed them to checkbox items (`- [ ]`) in the note's text so they can be ticked. Nothing else in the note changed. Ticks on the page are saved back into the note.
